title: Surreal Mustache Crown
description: A surreal fantasy landscape features a giant black mustache with two crescent moons as eyes floating in a purple cosmic sky above an ornate golden crown. Below, a vibrant green valley contains a glowing blue lake with an island, a large stylized tree, a distant mountain, and a silhouette of a person with dreadlocks on the left. Colorful abstract ribbon shapes curve through the foreground.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape with a giant black mustache and two crescent moons floating in a swirling purple cosmic sky, an ornate golden crown hovering beneath it, below is a lush green valley with a glowing blue lake and small island, stylized tree on the left, distant mountain, silhouette of a dreadlocked person gazing at the scene, colorful abstract ribbon forms in the foreground, vibrant dreamlike atmosphere
